_comment: The six playable monsters. Choosing a monster chooses its element. `cell` is the picture's number in vendor/opengameart/tiny-creatures.png — 16x16 cells, 10 across, 18 down, so cell n sits at x = (n % 10) * 16, y = floor(n / 10) * 16. Names describe what the sprite actually looks like.
